args.text:
1. Read the rules at game start; know my role before judging anyone.
2. Loyal seat: propose crews of players with clean records; include myself when it is sound.
3. Track each stage's damage count against crew size; a crew with damage is suspect, not proven.
4. Use the audit on the most suspicious seat who was on a damaged stage.
5. Vote no on a lead whose crew contains a seat that already showed damage.
6. Play safe as loyal; as saboteur, damage only when the stage is unlikely to be blamed on me.
7. Watch who pushes others to vote yes quickly; rushing is a warning sign.
8. Accuse at the end only with evidence from the record.
